Metadata association atlas. The Issue 226 cross-sectional fixture experiment uses the rna layer
to assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with control. (A) condition
observations are shown against component PC1. (B) condition observations are shown against
component PC2. Boxplots summarize categorical component scores; points show individual
observations. For the declared control to treatment contrast, grey identifies control
(reference) and red identifies treatment (comparison). Point size records coincident
observations. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is
cross-sectional; the estimand is prespecified component-metadata association. Stored intervals
and diagnostics remain descriptive. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction
across declared components within each metadata field and evidence variant. No acceptance
threshold is applied. The atlas is exploratory and does not nominate a biological coordinate.
